subject: maths
question: The diameter of a hemispherical bowl is 11.2 cm. How many litres of liquid can it hold ? (Use pi = (22)/(7) and round off your answer to three decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter = 11.2 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 × π × r³

1 litre = 1000 cm³

**Calculation:**

⇒ Radius r = 11.2 ÷ 2 = 5.6

⇒ Volume = 2/3 × 22/7 × (5.6)³

⇒ (5.6)³ = 175.616

⇒ Volume = 2/3 × 22/7 × 175.616

⇒ = 2/3 × 551.936

⇒ = 1103.872 ÷ 3

⇒ = 367.957 cm³

⇒ In litres = 367.957 ÷ 1000

⇒ = 0.368

**∴ The correct answer is 0.368 litres.**
